items.text: The Linux feedback composer links its draft folder, and files dropped in ride along.
A GTK window lists its panes in a sidebar: rail and panel on one button, Ctrl+Shift+S, shared and remembered.
A GTK viewer page's iframe can no longer file a quote, set the contents or open a file.
The chooser Kill-hover check measures the Kill button again, not the Show button beside it.
The Linux feedback composer follows the light/dark style.
